scripts.dev:api: npm run build && npx --yes wrangler@4 d1 migrations apply DB --local && npx --yes wrangler@4 dev --port 8787
scripts.deploy: npm run build && npx --yes wrangler@4 deploy
scripts.db:migrate: npx --yes wrangler@4 d1 migrations apply DB --remote
scripts.demo:seed: node scripts/demo-data.mjs seed > demo-data.sql && npx --yes wrangler@4 d1 execute DB --remote --file demo-data.sql -y
scripts.demo:remove: node scripts/demo-data.mjs remove > demo-data.sql && npx --yes wrangler@4 d1 execute DB --remote --file demo-data.sql -y
